responsibility: This definition module declares textual I/O and conversion routines for ordinal numeric types in the gm2 base libraries. It belongs to the numeric formatting subsystem and exports read/write procedures plus string conversions for CARDINAL and INTEGER values in decimal, hexadecimal, octal, and binary forms, including helper entry points that parse non-decimal strings into signed integers.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition half of the NumberIO pair: it declares the exported read/write and string-conversion procedures for decimal, hex, octal, and binary integers. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/NumberIO.mod, it does not implement parsing, formatting, whitespace skipping, or StrIO integration.
